name: Virat Crane Industries Limited
about: Virat Crane Industries Limited produces and sells dairy products in India. The company procures and processes milk and milk products, such as ghee, cow ghee, milk, curd, and butter milk under the Durga, Bhavani, and Kamadhenu brands. It also offers cheese, paneer, lassi, and ice-cream. The company serves the retail trade sector. Virat Crane Industries Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Guntur, India.
